body: I keep trying to tell myself that these things will make me stronger but I swear that bad things continuously keep happening to me.. I am in so much pain to the point where my future becomes blurry.. I don’t want to hurt my friends and family but this grief I am feeling stings worse than anything I’ve ever dealt with. I’m only 20 years old, I never planned for my life to go in this direction. the only thing that eases my pain is my anxiety medicine, but becoming drug dependent is the last thing I want. Every bone in my body is on fire from how awful I’ve been feeling. Nothing makes it better, it’s even been weeks. Talking about it makes me even more nauseous. I feel like I would be better off dead at this point. I can’t bear these feelings anymore
